title: Inner-anodyne relative inclusion of the arrow-prism collage
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, internal functor simplicial sets, nerves and degreewise products from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], relative joins from [def-coef-infinity-relative-join], and inner anodyne maps from [lem-coef-inner-anodyne-pushout-product]. Let $X$ be any small simplicial set, $B\subseteq\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,X)$ any simplicial subset, and $v:B\to X$ target evaluation. Put $J=B\star_X X$ using $v$ and $1_X$. For an $n$-simplex $x$ of $J$, write $i\in\{-1,\ldots,n\}$ for its last initial-block index. Its data are an initial arrow prism $q:\Delta^1\times\Delta^i\to X$ and a target-coordinate simplex $\sigma:\Delta^n\to X$ with $q(1,-)=\sigma|_{[i]}$; when $i=-1$ there is no prism.
Let $P_x$ be the nerve of the poset with chains $s_0<\cdots<s_i$ and $t_0<\cdots<t_n$, and cross relations $s_j\leq t_l$ exactly for $j\leq l$, with no relation from a $t$ to an $s$. Let $Q_x\subseteq P_x$ be the union of the prism on $s_0,\ldots,s_i,t_0,\ldots,t_i$ and the simplex on all $t_l$. An empty source list is omitted. For a simplex operator $\alpha:[m]\to[n]$, the maps $P_{\alpha^*x}\to P_x$ send each retained source or target vertex to the vertex of the same type with index $\alpha(j)$; these maps also take $Q_{\alpha^*x}$ into $Q_x$.
Define $P$ to be the degreewise quotient of $\coprod_{x\in J_n,\ n\geq0}P_x$ by all these simplex-operator identifications, with the induced simplicial operators, and let $Q\subseteq P$ be the union of the images of the $Q_x$. For any simplicial subset $H\subseteq J$, let $P_H\subseteq P$ be the union of the images of $P_h$ for all simplices $h$ of $H$. Then the inclusion $Q\cup P_H\hookrightarrow P$ is inner anodyne. Evaluation of the prism part by $q$ and of the target simplex by $\sigma$ gives a well-defined simplicial map $Q\to X$. The chains $s_0<\cdots<s_i<t_{i+1}<\cdots<t_n$ define a simplicial map $d:J\to P$, with the evident pure-factor conventions. No quasicategory hypothesis on $X$ is required.
